aov-air-handling.name: SE Controls
lines: OS2 smoke-control panels
Chain and linear actuators on stair and façade vents
Fire-alarm interface on schemes we commission
aov-air-handling.framing: We install and service SE Controls smoke ventilation on residential stairs and commercial blocks. Equipment and labour are quoted after we see the fire strategy and the vents already fitted. There is no SE Controls price list on this page.

aov-air-handling.name: Nuaire
lines: Smoke extract fans used with stair and lobby schemes
Controls on existing Nuaire plant
Filter and fan service on units already installed
aov-air-handling.framing: We commission and service Nuaire ventilation where it forms part of a smoke-control scheme. Supply and labour are POA after survey.

aov-air-handling.name: Brooks
lines: Actuators on Brooks-labelled smoke vents
Control panels on those schemes
Planned tests of vents already fitted
aov-air-handling.framing: We service Brooks smoke-vent equipment that is already on site. We name the model only after we have seen it. If it cannot be repaired safely we say so before quoting a replacement. POA.

aov-air-handling.name: Ventilux
lines: Life-safety controls carrying the Ventilux name on stair schemes
Power and interface checks on that equipment
aov-air-handling.framing: Ventilux appears on some life-safety schemes we maintain. We identify the panel before quoting parts or a change. No catalogue price.

aov-air-handling.name: Geze
lines: Slimchain and Powerchain window drives
RWA control panels
Door operators only where they sit on the smoke path we are asked to service
aov-air-handling.framing: We install and service Geze RWA drives and controls. Supply and labour are POA after survey.

aov-air-handling.name: D+H Mechatronic
lines: CDC chain drives
Locking actuators on smoke vents
SHEV control panels on existing D+H schemes
aov-air-handling.framing: We work on D+H smoke-vent drives and panels. Parts and installation are quoted after the survey.

aov-air-handling.name: TROX
lines: Smoke and fire dampers
Smoke extract components specified with the air system
aov-air-handling.framing: We service TROX dampers and extract components that sit in the smoke path. Prices are POA.

aov-air-handling.name: Colt
lines: Natural smoke ventilation already installed under Colt schemes
Mechanical smoke extract on those schemes
Roof and façade vents we are asked to test or replace
aov-air-handling.framing: We maintain and replace Colt smoke ventilation where it is the system on the building. New schemes follow the fire strategy. Supply and labour are POA.

aov-air-handling.name: Smoke Control
lines: Smoke-control panels listed under this name
Actuators and vents on those installations
aov-air-handling.framing: Where the equipment is badged Smoke Control, we service the installed system. We confirm the panel before ordering parts. POA.

aov-air-handling.name: ASSA ABLOY
lines: Door closers on escape routes
Operators that the smoke strategy relies on
aov-air-handling.framing: We service ASSA ABLOY door hardware that has to release or close as part of the smoke strategy. This is door hardware, not an AOV panel brand. Hardware and labour are POA.

aov-air-handling.name: Group SCS
lines: Smoke-control panels on Group SCS schemes
Actuators supplied with those schemes
aov-air-handling.framing: We attend Group SCS smoke-control systems for fault-finding and planned tests. Parts and labour are POA after we identify the panel.

aov-air-handling.name: WindowMaster
lines: MotorLink actuators
Natural ventilation controls used for smoke and everyday opening
aov-air-handling.framing: We install and service WindowMaster actuators and controls on smoke-vent windows. Quotes are POA.

aov-air-handling.name: Simon RWA
lines: SHEV chain drives
Compact control panels on existing Simon RWA vents
aov-air-handling.framing: We service Simon RWA drives and panels. Replacement supply is POA once the model is known.

aov-air-handling.name: Bilco
lines: Automatic smoke vents
Roof hatches used as smoke outlets
aov-air-handling.framing: We service Bilco smoke vents and roof hatches. Replacement units and labour are POA.

aov-air-handling.name: Cambric
lines: Smoke ventilation equipment on Cambric schemes already installed
aov-air-handling.framing: We maintain Cambric smoke ventilation that is already fitted. We do not publish a Cambric price list.

aov-air-handling.name: Kingspan Air
lines: Air-handling plant tied to smoke extract
Fan and control checks on that plant
aov-air-handling.framing: We service Kingspan air-handling plant where it is part of the smoke strategy. Equipment and labour are POA.

aov-air-handling.name: FlaktGroup
lines: Smoke extract fans
Air-handling units on the same schemes
aov-air-handling.framing: We service FlaktGroup extract fans and air-handling plant used for smoke control. POA after survey.

aov-air-handling.name: Systemair
lines: Smoke extract fans
Controls on existing Systemair plant
aov-air-handling.framing: We install and service Systemair smoke extract fans. Supply and labour are POA.

barriers.name: CAME
lines: Gard 5m barrier packs published on this site
BAR-5M-STD, BAR-5M-VIDEX, BAR-5M-PAXTON, BAR-5M-GSM and BAR-5M-ALLIN
Safety loops, beams and edges surveyed with the lane
barriers.framing: CAME is our barrier partner. The pack prices on this card are supply only, ex VAT, and match the figures already published for those SKUs. Installation, civils, power and safety commissioning are quoted after a site survey. We do not add a day-rate here.

barriers.name: FAAC
lines: Existing FAAC boom barriers
Safety edges and loops on those lanes
barriers.framing: We fault-find and repair existing FAAC barriers when parts and the safety devices still allow a safe repair. New barrier supply on this site is CAME unless the survey shows the existing estate should be matched. FAAC equipment and labour are POA.

barriers.name: BFT
lines: Existing BFT boom barriers
Lane safety devices on those installs
barriers.framing: We service existing BFT barriers. New supply is through the CAME partnership unless the installed estate should stay on BFT. Parts and labour are POA.

barriers.name: Nice
lines: Existing Nice boom barriers
Controls and safety devices on those lanes
barriers.framing: We attend existing Nice barriers for faults and like-for-like repairs. A new lane is specified as CAME unless there is a reason to match Nice. POA.

barriers.name: Magnetic Autocontrol
lines: Existing Magnetic boom barriers
Lane safety devices fitted with them
barriers.framing: We service Magnetic Autocontrol barriers already on site. Replacement supply is POA. New installs are CAME unless the survey says otherwise.

barriers.name: Automatic Systems
lines: Existing Automatic Systems parking barriers
Safety devices on those lanes
barriers.framing: We fault-find Automatic Systems barriers where they are already installed. Parts and labour are POA. New partner supply is CAME.

barriers.name: Beninca
lines: Existing Beninca barrier operators
Safety edges and loops on those lanes
barriers.framing: We repair existing Beninca barriers when a safe repair is realistic. We will say if it is not. New supply is CAME unless the estate should be matched. POA.

barriers.name: Roger Technology
lines: Existing Roger Technology barrier operators
Lane safety devices on those installs
barriers.framing: We service Roger Technology barriers already fitted. Equipment and labour are POA. New lanes are CAME unless the survey shows a match is the better repair.

barriers.name: Ditec
lines: Existing Ditec boom barriers
Safety devices on those lanes
barriers.framing: We attend existing Ditec barriers. Parts and labour are POA. New barrier supply on this site is CAME unless an existing Ditec estate should be kept.

barriers.name: Elka
lines: Existing Elka parking barriers
Booms and safety devices on those lanes
barriers.framing: We service Elka barriers that are already installed. We do not publish an Elka price. New supply is CAME unless the survey says to match Elka.

barriers.name: SEA
lines: Existing SEA barrier operators
Safety devices on those lanes
barriers.framing: We fault-find existing SEA barriers. Parts and labour are POA. New partner supply is CAME.
